entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Arimardan Yadav,Jadu Nandan Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.

By means of this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., applicant Sanjay Yadav @ Devendra, who is involved in Case Crime No. 344 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, police station Thathiya, district Kannauj, seeks enlargement on bail during the pendency of trial.

On the matter being taken up, Mr. Arimardan Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant submits that during pendency of this bail application, the applicant has been acquitted from the trial Court,
therefore, cause of filing the instant bail application has lost its efficacy.
In view of the statement made by learned counsel for the applicant at the bar, the instant bail application is dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.
